images.prompt: Photoreal interior architectural photograph of an empty modern hospital inpatient ward exam room, 16:9, eye-level standing height (~1.6 m), camera positioned near the center of the room, facing directly toward one wall which holds a single closed door. Room: rectangular, 8.77 m wide by 7.77 m deep, flat 2.42 m suspended ceiling, perfectly flat walls with square corners, no curved surfaces anywhere. Walls: off-white matte painted drywall, flat and planar. Base: a straight grey vinyl cove base, 100 mm tall, running along the wall-floor junction; it is a thin strip that stays flat against the wall and only curves in a small ~15 mm radius where it meets the floor -- never a tall curved bench or ledge shape. Floor: pale near-white sheet vinyl flooring with faint linear seams, perfectly flat and level, meeting the cove base at a sharp straight line. Ceiling: suspended acoustic ceiling with perfectly square 600mm x 600mm acoustic tiles set in a straight white T-bar grid running parallel to the walls; grid lines are dead straight in both directions. Light fixture: exactly one flat rectangular recessed LED troffer panel, 600mm x 1200mm, centered in the ceiling grid roughly in the middle of the room, its lens flush and coplanar with the surrounding ceiling tiles. It is a FLAT panel -- absolutely NOT a cylindrical tube fixture, NOT a parabolic louvered fixture, and it does not hang below or sit proud of the ceiling plane. Door: one maple wood veneer door, 0.95 m wide by 2.10 m tall, closed, centered on the wall the camera faces but offset slightly right of center (its centerline sits 4.20 m from the left corner of that wall). It has a single narrow vertical vision-lite window in its upper half, offset toward its right edge, and a simple white painted door casing/trim. The door's hinges are on its right side (as seen in this view) and it is shown closed. No windows anywhere in the room. No furniture, no people, no equipment, no clutter, no text, no signage, no watermark, no logo. Daylight-balanced, even, shadowless lighting throughout.
